_comment: Physical cards carry an ArUco marker. Game cards use markers 0-31; player (credit) cards use 100-102 so the two can never be confused. Effects are applied by the rules module (milestone 4). Classic house-repair cards are swapped for flat payments because houses are out of scope.

cards.title: Homeward Charm
cards.text: Advance to Castle Gate. Collect 200.

cards.title: Dragon Summons
cards.text: Advance to Dragon's Lair. If you pass Castle Gate, collect 200.

cards.title: Meadow Breeze
cards.text: Advance to Goose Girl's Meadow. If you pass Castle Gate, collect 200.
